description: Kiva is a C++ foundation heat-transfer model intended for use in building-energy calculations. The repository documents timestep simulation of heat exchange through ground-contact foundations and provides build instructions. It supplies a reusable physical calculation, not a fixed building inventory. Soil and construction assumptions, mesh setup and boundary conditions affect the outputs. Published by bigladder (repository owner). Spatial and temporal resolution are source-dependent; any detail not stated above remains unknown. Access is through the provider documentation and software links; no software was installed. Reuse licence: BSD-3-Clause. The described release is free to access; licence restrictions still apply. Potential simulation uses include climate adaptation, optimisation. Related catalogue records: model-energyplus. These are contextual links, not a claim of a tested integration.
